component.name: Ray Player
component.summary: Modern IPTV player for live TV, movies and series

description.p: Ray Player is a high-performance desktop IPTV player featuring support for live television channels, movies, and TV series with automatic stream recovery, M3U and Xtream Codes playlist management, and Google Account synchronization.

ul.li: Live stream stall detection and automatic recovery watchdog
Wide multimedia format compatibility with embedded VLC and MPV engines
Hardware accelerated playback and subtitle support
Intuitive modern user interface built with Compose Desktop

description.p: Performance optimizations and automatic live stream watchdog recovery.
